title: Texas Standard for Oct. 1, 2026: Houston voters weigh marijuana enforcement priorities
summary: More than 3,500 people have been prosecuted for misdemeanor marijuana possession in Harris County over the past three years. Houston voters will soon decide whether to direct police to deprioritize...
content: More than 3,500 people have been prosecuted for misdemeanor marijuana possession in Harris County over the past three years. Houston voters will soon decide whether to direct police to deprioritize those cases through the proposed Houston Freedom Act. But local officials say the measure may have limited practical effect.
